advancement.legendary_spellbooks.title: Legendary Spellbooks
death.attack.legendary_spellbooks.annihi: %1$s was obliterated by a resonant annihilation blast from %2$s
death.attack.legendary_spellbooks.cloud_: %1$s was engulfed and crushed by %2$s's clouds
death.attack.legendary_spellbooks.flame_: %1$s was consumed by the subterranean flames summoned by %2$s
spell.legendary_spellbooks.annihilation_: Channel a devastating beam of pure annihilation. While firing, you are locked in place. When aimed horizontally near the ground, the beam's overwhelming power causes it to scatter unstable energy orbs across the terrain.

Launch a concentrated orb of annihilation that detonates upon impact with a creature or the ground. The resulting explosion deals heavy damage and scatters a multitude of unstable energy orbs across the surrounding area.
Create a massive gravitational well that pulls in nearby creatures. Upon completing the cast, a colossal geyser of destructive energy erupts, finishing with a devastating explosion.
Enhance your weaponry with an unstable frequency. For the duration of the spell, landing a critical hit triggers a powerful annihilation explosion at the point of impact.

Stomp the ground to release a fan-shaped shockwave of green annihilation fire. The flames erupt in successive waves, consuming the life force of all creatures caught in the tremor. Damage increases based on the target's maximum health.
spell.legendary_spellbooks.cloud_rail.gu: Conjure a cascading line of magical clouds in front of you. These clouds fall freely from the sky, exploding and dealing area damage upon impact with the ground.
spell.legendary_spellbooks.cloud_ring.gu: Conjure multiple expanding rings of magical clouds centered on your position. These clouds descend from the sky in a rhythmic cascade, dealing heavy area damage upon impacting the ground.
spell.legendary_spellbooks.energy_beam.g: Ascend into the air and remain suspended to unleash an ultra-high output laser. The overwhelming energy consumption leaves the caster stunned for a short duration after the beam concludes.
spell.legendary_spellbooks.flame_eater.g: Target multiple creatures to erupt a burst of fire at their feet. This spell fails to reach targets positioned too high above the ground.
Emit a radial burst of fire in equally spaced directions around you. These flames travel along the ground, erupting at the feet of creatures in their path. This spell fails to manifest if the caster are too high above the ground.
Summon a row of thunderclouds in front of you that continuously strike lightning upon anything beneath them for the duration of the spell.
spell.legendary_spellbooks.overgrown_sho: Slam the ground to unleash a burst of toxic nature magic in a large radius around you, poisoning all creatures caught in the tremor.
Unleash multiple violent vortexes in a radial burst around you. These tornadoes travel outwards in equally spaced directions, pulling in and immobilizing any creatures caught in their path.
spell.legendary_spellbooks.thunder_fanbu: Unleash a fanned burst of lightning bolts that travel outwards in multiple directions. These bolts pierce through all creatures in their path.
spell.legendary_spellbooks.tornado.guide: Summon a violent vortex that pulls in all nearby creatures. Those caught in its grasp are rendered immobile, trapped within the eye of the raging storm.
spell.legendary_spellbooks.triple_nimbus: Manifest three rows of thunderclouds in a fanned formation. These clouds continuously strike lightning upon anything beneath them for the duration of the spell.
tooltip.legendary_spellbooks.annihilator: Grants a 10% chance to teleport away upon taking damage, effectively neutralizing the threat.
tooltip.legendary_spellbooks.stormbound_: This spellbook calls forth thunder, causing rain to swell into storms.
